models.label: ECMWF IFS 0.25°
models.note: ECMWF's operational physics model, open-data release. Its gust field is a maximum over the output interval, not an instantaneous value, so gust factors look large in light air.

models.label: ECMWF AIFS
models.note: ECMWF's machine-learning model - a genuinely independent opinion. Publishes no gust field, so gusts come from IFS and ICON-2i only.

models.label: ItaliaMeteo ICON-2i
models.note: ItaliaMeteo / ARPAE high-resolution model for Italy - the finest grid available here. Runs only ~60-72 h ahead and updates every 12 h, so it drops out of the longer-range view.

models.label: Météo-France MFWAM
models.note: Full sea-state decomposition - total wave, wind wave and swell with heights, directions and periods.

models.label: ECMWF WAM 0.25°
models.note: Total significant wave height only - used to cross-check MFWAM.

briefing.headline: Light NW-to-NE air and 1-2 ft seas over the Aeolians now - but departure is 11 days out and well beyond any model's reach.
briefing.synopsis: Current pattern over the islands is slack: ECMWF IFS and AIFS (both 22 Sep 00Z), with ICON-2i at 2 km, agree on 5-9 kt from the NW today, backing through E/NE overnight into 23 Sep at 8-9 kt around Panarea and Stromboli, then collapsing to 1-4 kt by 24 Sep. Total seas run 0.4-1.7 ft at most islands, peaking at 2.3 ft off Filicudi midday 23 Sep (MFWAM 21 Sep 12Z, cross-checked by ECMWF WAM 22 Sep 00Z). The forecast horizon ends 28 Sep, so this is a description of the pattern in place now, not of the trip.
briefing.overnight_anchorage: No berth is assigned tonight in a planning sense, but the rehearsal scores Portorosa Marina as fully sheltered for tonight, 22 Sep - enclosed basin, all-round protection, and the choice does not matter at these wind speeds. Nothing in the payload would push a fleet off a berth anywhere in the islands over the next few days. For the trip itself, we have no berth data at all yet.
briefing.tomorrow_morning: For the rehearsal run on 23 Sep, Portorosa shows 3.9 kt from the S at 06:00 with 0.8 ft of sea (IFS/AIFS/ICON-2i, 22 Sep 00Z), so an early departure window is wide open in the current pattern. Real departure day is 4 Oct and is beyond the 28 Sep horizon - no useful guidance yet. Expect the first genuinely relevant model runs about six to seven days before you sail.

passage_notes.note: Rehearsal on 23 Sep: 5.2 kt, a run, verdict go. No forecast yet for 4 Oct.
Rehearsal on 24 Sep: 2.5 kt close reach - motoring air. Trip date out of range.
Rehearsal on 25 Sep: 7.1 kt broad reach, within comfortable limits for a 45ft cat.

passage_notes.leg: Stromboli → Panarea, optional return (real date 6 Oct)
passage_notes.note: Rehearsal on 26 Sep: 7.3 kt broad reach; a 26 kt interval-maximum gust from one model only, not treated as a caution.
Rehearsal on 27 Sep: 4.0 kt broad reach; a lone 33 kt interval-max gust figure against a 4 kt mean - an artefact of light air, not a squall signal.
Rehearsal on 28 Sep: 1.5 kt - the far edge of the horizon. Nothing for 8 Oct.

cautions: Every leg and berth figure here is rehearsal only, scored against 23-28 Sep weather. None of it applies to 4-8 Oct.
Two hours show real model spread worth knowing about: Lipari 06:00 on 23 Sep ranges 2.1-8.4 kt and Stromboli the same hour 4.8-10.9 kt across models - the mean is not a reliable single number there.
The large gust factors (e.g. 33 kt at Filicudi against a 4 kt mean) come from IFS's interval-maximum gust field in light air and from a single model; treat them as reported, not forecast.
briefing.confidence_note: Stability checks show only 0.9-1.6 kt mean wind shift between runs but direction wandering up to 52 degrees by 72-120 h, and the trip dates sit entirely past the 28 Sep forecast horizon - so no confidence at all can be attached to the departure period yet.

verification.measures: forecast stability, not verified accuracy - the reference is the newest model run for the same hour, not an observation
